1.why: ingenuous/ingenious near-homophone decoy: 'clever' and 'cunning' mutually cancel as a synonym pair, and their presence names the headword ingenuous, so the key is naive.

2.why: C (buoyancy:lifejacket) and D (insulation:warmth) are a mirrored property/object pair, so the relation is object-to-property and D is the non-reversed member.

3.why: C and E share the person:adjective shape with E inverted (skeptic is NOT credulous), the classic key-plus-reversal pair, so the matching member C is the key.

4.why: D (stir:spoon) and E (shovel:dig) are mirrored action/tool; the reversal trap is the awkwardly ordered D, leaving tool-to-its-function E.

5.why: dwindle/swell is an antonym key-plus-trap pair and dwindle is the semantically loaded member (wane/ebb family); lexical prior only.

6.why: sieve:strain is the only tool-to-defining-function pair; the others are part:whole, stage, and two place-association pairs that partly duplicate each other.

7.why: compete/defeat/triumph form the contest cluster with boast and support as field outliers; triumph is the intense member typical of an SSAT headword. Lexical prior.

8.why: 'high-spirited' is the only hyphenated compound (form outlier) and eloquent reads as an ebullient-shaped phonetic decoy; weak, lexical prior.

9.why: Longest, most qualified gloss ('able to turn skillfully to many different tasks'); directional bet that the key gloss needs the most precision.

10.why: 'tactful' is a phonetic decoy naming the withheld headword tacit, whose synonym is unspoken; explicit is the planted antonym.

11.why: odometer:distance is the only instrument-to-quantity-measured pair, the tightest relation in the set, and that family recurs in this batch (item 26).

12.why: A and D are a mirrored degree pair; directional bet on extreme-to-mild order makes gluttonous:hungry the key and confident:arrogant the reversal.

13.why: Longest gloss ('stay suspended in one place above' = hover); same directional bet as items 9, 18, 28.

14.why: 'tiny' reads as a phonetic decoy for timorous/timid, making shy the key; weaker instance of the decoy channel.

15.why: 'sidewalk' is a noun among verbs and is only there as the other sense of the headword CURB, so the key is the verbal sense, restrain.

16.why: starving:hungry is the only degree pair and matches the extreme-to-mild direction I am betting on batch-wide; generous:stingy is a recycled cross-item distractor.

17.why: 'fragrant' is a phonetic decoy for fragile/frail; sturdy is the antonym and broken the overshoot, leaving delicate.

18.why: Longest gloss ('spread through every part of something' = permeate); same directional bet as 9, 13, 28.

19.why: mordant/mournful is the only near-homophone pair available, which would make mournful the decoy and sarcastic the key; thin.

20.why: A (urn:ashes) and C (coop:chicken) are near-duplicate container:contents pairs so neither can be keyed, and knot:speed is the uniquely tight unit-to-quantity relation.

21.why: overjoyed is the intense member of an emotion set whose others are mild states; lexical prior, no structural tell.

22.why: A and E are near-duplicate worker:product pairs and cancel; B/C are mirrored person/tool, and person-first is the canonical stem order.

23.why: C and E are a mirrored degree pair; same extreme-to-mild directional bet selects terrified:nervous.

24.why: 'valiant' is a phonetic decoy for the headword vacant, and occupied is its planted antonym, so the key is empty.

25.why: fleet:ship is the only group-to-member pair and the tightest relation present; A/B are a mirrored product/material pair.

26.why: compass:bearing is instrument-to-reading, the same family that item 11 keys; B and E are a mirrored person/tool pair and cancel each other.

27.why: B and E are mirrored part/whole; betting on part-to-whole as the canonical stem order gives branch:tree.

28.why: Longest gloss ('producing a large profit' = lucrative); same directional bet as 9, 13, 18.

29.why: B (heat:temperature) and D (humid:weather) are near-duplicate property-to-dimension pairs and cancel; damp:saturated is the only degree pair left.

30.why: B and E are mirrored instance/category; instance-to-category is the canonical order, giving generosity:virtue.
